title: Cisco IOS Navigation and Initial Device Configuration
summary: Master Cisco IOS CLI command mode navigation, context-sensitive help, line configuration, administrative password protection, banners, and NVRAM configuration saving.
learning_objectives: Navigate between User EXEC, Privileged EXEC, Global Configuration, and sub-configuration modes
Use CLI assistance features including Tab auto-completion and context-sensitive help (?)
Configure device hostnames, legal banners (MOTD), and encrypted enable secrets
Secure physical console and virtual terminal (VTY) lines with passwords
Save the active configuration from RAM to NVRAM using copy running-config startup-config

source.origin: Independently authored educational guide replacing legacy courseware activities 2.3.7 and 2.5.5
